tools.name: image
tools.description: Text-to-image generation with FLUX.1 schnell. Send a prompt, get a 1024x1024 JPEG back as base64 in a few seconds. Use for illustrations, thumbnails, mockups, avatars and social media images. Optional steps parameter (1-8, default 4) trades speed for detail. Example: prompt=a lighthouse on a cliff a

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe speech from an audio file at a public URL using Whisper large-v3-turbo. Returns the transcript text, detected language, duration and word count. Accepts common formats such as MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG up to 5 MB. Use for voice notes, podcast clips, meeting snippets and voice messages. Exampl

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Vision model for an image at a public URL: get a detailed description including any visible text, or pass a question to ask something specific about the image. Accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF up to 3 MB. Use for alt text, OCR-style reading of screenshots, chart reading and content checks. Price $0.0

tools.name: ai_chat
tools.description: Send a prompt, get an answer from Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, with an optional system prompt, up to 1,024 output tokens and adjustable temperature. Use for drafting, reasoning steps, Q&A and any quick LLM call without an AI provider account. For harder reasoning use ai_chat_large. Example: prompt=Explain

tools.name: ai_chat_large
tools.description: Send a prompt, get an answer from a larger open model: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct (default) or OpenAI gpt-oss-120b, with an optional system prompt, up to 1,024 output tokens and adjustable temperature. Same call as /ai/chat with a stronger model. Use when the 8B model is not enough: reasoning, drafting

tools.name: ai_summarize_text
tools.description: Summarize up to 12,000 characters of text you send into a few sentences plus bullet key points. Use for long emails, documents, transcripts and tool outputs (for a web page by URL, use /summarize). Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. tools.name: ai_sentiment
tools.description: Positive or negative sentiment of English text with a confidence score, from a DistilBERT model fine-tuned on SST-2. Use to triage reviews, support messages, social posts and replies. Example: text=The checkout was fast and support answered within minutes.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card k

tools.name: ai_classify
tools.description: Zero-shot classification: give text and 2-20 candidate labels, get the best label, a short reason and a ranking. Use for routing tickets, tagging content, intent detection and moderation queues. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and ch

tools.name: ai_keywords
tools.description: The most important keywords and key phrases of a text, most relevant first. Use for tagging, SEO, search indexing and topic detection. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free

tools.name: ai_rewrite
tools.description: Rewrite text to be more formal, casual, simpler, shorter, friendlier, more professional or more persuasive, keeping the meaning and language. Use to polish emails, replies, product copy and messages. Example: text=hey, cant make it tmrw, can we move to thu?. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card

tools.name: ai_outline
tools.description: A structured Markdown outline (headings and bullet points) of a text you send, or a suggested outline for a topic. Use to plan articles, reports, talks and documentation. Example: text=How small businesses can accept stablecoin payments. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); faile

tools.name: ai_translate
tools.description: Translate text between about 100 languages with Meta's M2M100 1.2B model. Give the target language as an ISO code such as en, sv, de, fr, es, zh or ja; the source language is optional. Use to localise messages and documents. Example: text=Payment received, thank you!, to=sv. Price $0.01/call via x40

tools.name: ai_embed
tools.description: A 1,024-dimension embedding vector for up to 4,000 characters of text in 100+ languages, from BAAI's BGE-M3. Use for semantic search, RAG retrieval, clustering and deduplication. Example: text=pay-per-call APIs for AI agents. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free

tools.name: ai_extract_json
tools.description: Pull named fields out of unstructured text (emails, invoices, listings, bios) and get them back as a JSON object, with null for anything not present. Use to turn messy text into structured data for an agent. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or compute

tools.name: ai_speech
tools.description: Turn up to 1,000 characters of text into natural speech as an audio file (base64, with its content type), in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese or Korean, with MeloTTS. Use for voice replies, audio notes, accessibility and phone or chat bots. Example: text=Your payment was received. Thank y

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: describe, ai_chat, ai_chat_large, ai_classify, ai_extract_json · Private data: transcribe, ai_chat, ai_chat_large, ai_summarize_text, ai_translate, ai_speech · Public sink: image, ai_chat, ai_chat_large, ai_summarize_text, ai_outline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: describe, ai_chat, ai_chat_large, ai_classify, ai_extract_json · Private data: transcribe, ai_chat, ai_chat_large, ai_summarize_text, ai_translate, ai_speech · Public sink: image, ai_chat, ai_chat_large, ai_summarize_text, ai_outline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
